stemMd: How many zeros occur at the end of the decimal representation of 18 factorial?
explanationMd: Each trailing zero requires a factor 10, hence a pair of factors 2 and 5. Twos are plentiful; the factors 5, 10 and 15 supply three fives, and no multiple of 25 occurs. Thus there are three zeros.
